pins.title: What to Pack for a Waterfront Cottage Weekend
pins.description: What to actually pack for a waterfront cottage stay on Virginia's Northern Neck: a stinger suit for jellyfish season, binoculars, slip-on shoes for the dock, and a few things guests wish they had brought.
pins.altText: Two glasses of wine on a dock rail at sunset over a Chesapeake creek.

pins.title: Packing List: Chesapeake Bay Cottage Stay
pins.description: A short packing list for a Chesapeake Bay cottage weekend. The obvious things you will remember; these are the ones that make the difference once you are on the water.
pins.altText: A wooden dock reaching into a calm tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck.

pins.title: Jellyfish Season on the Chesapeake: What to Bring
pins.description: Sea nettles drift through the lower Chesapeake for a few weeks between June and September. A thin stinger suit means you stop thinking about them. What else to pack for a Northern Neck stay.
pins.altText: A screened porch looking out over a quiet Chesapeake creek in summer.
